REF/BRRR Conversion.methodology: Tracks RHEA token outflows from rhea-conversion.sputnik-dao.near, representing REF and BRRR token conversions to RHEA

ref-brrr-conversion.name: REF/BRRR Conversion
ref-brrr-conversion.methodology: Tracks daily RHEA distributions from the conversion contract

Remaining REF/BRRR Conversion.methodology: Untracked portion of the 37% REF/BRRR Conversion allocation

remaining-conversion.name: Remaining Conversion
remaining-conversion.methodology: 37% total allocation minus on-chain tracked conversions

Community Incentives.methodology: RHEA tokens distributed on NEAR via airdrop.rhealab.near and ref-airdrop.near, tracked on-chain via Dune

community-incentives.name: Community Incentives
community-incentives.methodology: Tracks RHEA token transfers from airdrop accounts (airdrop.rhealab.near, ref-airdrop.near)

oRHEA Incentives.methodology: oRHEA to RHEA conversions tracked on-chain via Dune. oRHEA is a reputation-weighted incentive token earned through ecosystem participation, convertible to RHEA.

orhea-conversions.name: oRHEA Incentives
orhea-conversions.methodology: Tracks RHEA outflows from orhea-conv.rhealab.near, representing oRHEA-to-RHEA conversions by ecosystem participants

Remaining Airdrop & Incentives.methodology: Untracked portion of the 30.6% Airdrop and Incentives allocation

remaining-allocation.name: Remaining Allocation
remaining-allocation.methodology: 30.6% total allocation minus on-chain tracked airdrops and oRHEA conversions
